title: ON.energy scroll reveal
description: A wrapper whose content fades in, optionally rising a set distance, as it scrolls into view; siblings can be staggered with a delay.
notes: CSS only (view timeline); static HTML and older browsers show the content in place
name: on-energy-reveal

props.name: rise
props.description: how far it rises while fading in, in px (0 = fade only)

props.name: delay
props.description: pushes the start later, in % of the scroll range: staggers siblings
